_comment: Runtime configuration for the agent system. Contains NO secrets: a
provider's credential is named here by the GitHub Actions secret that
holds it, never by value. Changing a model or a retry limit must not
require touching workflow logic - that is the whole point of this file.
3. agentlib defaults            - per codebase (hard caps live here and

manager._why: Strategy, ambiguous-failure interpretation, escalation calls. Invoked rarely and only when reasoning is actually needed.

test_agent._why: Turning stated acceptance criteria into tests is bounded work against a contract the Director already wrote.

code_agent._why: Bounded implementation against committed tests. Escalates rather than re-deciding architecture.

distiller._why: Adds prose interpretation on top of an already-parsed failure structure. Cheapest tier; optional (see features.distiller_model_pass).

context_maintainer._why: Small targeted wiki edits against a known diff.

telemetry._prices_note: USD per million tokens. Used only to annotate records; an unpriced model records a null cost rather than a guessed one. Update when provider pricing changes.

_auto_merge_note: features.auto_merge is false and the workflows never set it true. Every agent-authored branch reaches main through a human-approved PR.
